events.title: Sabres vs. Penguins
events.addr: 1 Seymour H. Knox III Plaza, Buffalo, NY 14203
events.blurb: The Sabres host Pittsburgh on Black Friday night, a short walk from the Canalside rink.
events.blurbEs: Los Sabres reciben a Pittsburgh el Black Friday por la noche, a pasos de la pista de Canalside.

events.title: Skating at Ice at Canalside
events.blurb: Outdoor skating on the waterfront in its new spot next to Explore & More. Ages 5 and under skate free; rentals are $6.
events.blurbEs: Patinaje al aire libre junto al lago, ahora al lado de Explore & More. Menores de 5 gratis; alquiler de patines $6.

events.title: Home Alone in Concert
events.blurb: The Buffalo Philharmonic plays John Williams’ score live while the movie runs on the big screen.
events.blurbEs: La Filarmónica de Buffalo toca en vivo la música de John Williams mientras se proyecta la película.

events.title: Disney's Frozen
events.blurb: The Broadway musical opens its holiday run this weekend, with three shows Saturday and Sunday.
events.blurbEs: El musical de Broadway estrena su temporada navideña este fin de semana, con tres funciones sábado y domingo.

events.title: Bandits vs. Georgia Swarm
events.addr: 1 Seymour H. Knox III Plaza, Buffalo, NY 14203
events.blurb: The Bandits open their home season against Georgia. Pro lacrosse is loud, fast and great with a group.
events.blurbEs: Los Bandits abren su temporada en casa contra Georgia. Lacrosse profesional rápido y ruidoso, ideal en grupo.

events.title: Holiday Sip & Shop
events.blurb: Twenty local artisans, live music and a Mini Makers showcase of work by young artists in Wilson Town Square.
events.blurbEs: Veinte artesanos locales, música en vivo y una muestra de jóvenes artistas en Wilson Town Square.

events.title: Poinsettia Exhibit
events.blurb: Thousands of poinsettias fill the Victorian glass conservatory for the holidays. Last entry is 3:30 p.m.
events.blurbEs: Miles de flores de Pascua llenan el invernadero victoriano. Última entrada a las 3:30 p.m.

events.title: Candlelight Tour at the Martin House
events.blurb: A 90-minute docent-led tour of Wright’s Prairie house lit by candlelight. Three start times; book ahead.
events.blurbEs: Recorrido guiado de 90 minutos por la casa de Wright a la luz de las velas. Tres horarios; reserva antes.

events.title: Light Up Lancaster
events.blurb: The village tree lighting about 20 minutes east of downtown: live music, food and warm drinks, local vendors and a countdown to the lights.
events.blurbEs: El encendido del árbol del pueblo, a unos 20 minutos del centro: música en vivo, comida, bebidas calientes y cuenta regresiva.
